query:
SELECT
                commit_history.confirmed_at AS "confirmed_at!"
            FROM
                l1_batches
            INNER JOIN eth_txs_history AS commit_history
                ON commit_history.eth_tx_id = l1_batches.eth_commit_tx_id
            WHERE
                l1_batches.number = $1
                AND commit_history.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
            LIMIT
                1
